summary: First iteration full-stack testing of Inkwell book review MVP. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/refresh/logout/me), books (CRUD, external search via Google Books/Open Library fallback), reviews (CRUD, like toggle, sort, permissions), and comments (create/list/delete + owner/admin permissions). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow verified - landing page renders with hero and quotes marquee, ProtectedRoute redirects unauth users to /login, register creates account and redirects to /reviews, session persists via httpOnly cookies, manual book add works, 'Write a review' navigates with book_id preselected, review creation with 5-star rating works, like/share/comment on detail page all work, delete button visible to owner, feed sort toggle works, logout clears session, admin login works.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec - browsers will reject credentialed requests from cross-origin. Currently works because frontend uses same-origin via ingress proxy. For production/multi-origin support, set explicit CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env.
Fetches all reviews (limit 1000) into memory then slices in Python for pagination/sort. Will not scale beyond a few thousand reviews - move sort+skip+limit to MongoDB aggregation.
Rate-limit identifier uses request.client.host which behind ingress/proxy is typically the internal load-balancer IP - lockout may affect all users sharing that hop. Use X-Forwarded-For.

issues: Selected book cover shows broken image icon (alt 'TESTB') when cover_url is empty string - should render fallback placeholder instead of broken .
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription (console a11y warning).
Share button calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without try/catch fallback - throws 'Write permission denied' in headless/insecure contexts and no user-visible toast on failure.

action_items: Consider tightening CORS: replace allow_origins='*' with explicit list when allow_credentials=True (currently OK via same-origin ingress).
Handle empty cover_url in NewReview and BookCard - show placeholder image instead of broken .
Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch + fallback (e.g., prompt or execCommand copy) and always show a toast.
Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Radix Dialogs to remove a11y warnings.
Refactor GET /api/reviews to sort/skip/limit at MongoDB level for scalability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 578 lines - already close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, books, reviews, comments) before adding more features.
user_id in reviews/comments is stored as str(current_user['_id']) in some paths but current_user['_id'] is already stringified by get_current_user - consistent; good.
toggle_like computes likes_count from stale list length instead of re-querying - possible race condition under concurrent likes; acceptable for MVP.
seed_admin re-hashes and updates admin password on every startup if verify fails - idempotent and correct.
JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD read from env correctly, MongoDB via MONGO_URL - env hygiene good.
test_credentials: Admin admin@bookclub.com / Admin@123 works. Test users registered dynamically with TEST_/reader_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test users, one test book (TESTBOOK_*), one review, and comments created during tests. Admin deletes review as final step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with -o addopts='' to disable xdist parallelism because fixtures are session-scoped and share state). Frontend testids follow /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/*.js. Logout button testid is 'logout-button' (not 'nav-logout-button').
